subject: No solution found with ordered variables

messages.author: d56a920c0beb7fe0
messages.subject: No solution found with ordered variables
parts:
Hi There,

I am trying to run the following model:

"""
model_test <- '
s_i ~ v
s_e ~ v
s_q ~ s_i + s_e
r_q ~ s_q
'
fit_test <- sem(model_test, data = my_data, ordered = c('s_i', 's_e', 's_q', 'r_q'))
"""

'v' is my experimental variable, I have recoded it as a dummy variable that is either 0 or 1.
The rest of the variables are 5 star ratings, so I am treating them as ordered variables in the SEM function call.

When I do this I am being told that a solution has not been found. I am wondering is this because I am doing something incorrectly, because of a lack of data (525 samples) or some other reason?

When I run the model without the ordered argument the model converges.

Thanks,
Liam
